claims: Justin Rose has not won the Masters.
Justin Rose has three runner-up finishes at the Masters in 2015, 2017, and 2025.
Justin Rose has 16 top-25 finishes in 21 starts at Augusta National.
Justin Rose lost a playoff to Sergio Garcia in the 2017 Masters.
Justin Rose finished T2 at the 2025 Masters.
Justin Rose missed the cut at the 2024 Masters.
Justin Rose finished T16 at the 2023 Masters.
Justin Rose missed the cut at the 2022 Masters.
Justin Rose finished 7th at the 2021 Masters.
Justin Rose finished T23 at the 2020 Masters.
Justin Rose finished 2nd at the 2017 Masters.
Justin Rose finished T2 at the 2015 Masters
